name: Transient marine mammals
description: Functional group pooling the whales that occur only seasonally in PWS: fin whales, humpback whales, minke whales, beluga whales and transient (mammal-eating) killer whales, as defined by the source. Because baleen whales dominate the group's biomass, much of its diet is krill and small fish; the transient killer whale component preys on pinnipeds and other marine mammals. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in tonnes wet weight per km2, from Table 23 of the source.
